des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory; you can pick from the MCP services below or add new ones yourself.
Useful MCP services will keep being tested and added; contributions are welcome.
Remember to delete the comment lines; the des property is for description only and is not parsed.
The des and link properties only describe the install method and link to the original source; they are optional.
Three transport modes are currently supported: stdio (standard input/output), sse (Server-Sent Events), streamable-http (streamable HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Use Streamable HTTP transport mode, suitable for production web deployments
